findings.claim: Only a repository supervisor refreshes last_fallback_at, and only for connections it holds itself. A different long-lived process that keeps a cached fallback connection (for example the MCP server whose env still has the dead NATS_URL) is not counted, so the outage can be retired while that process is still isolated. Its next reconnect then mints a new outage and a second outage mail.
findings.evidence: holdsFallbackFrom inspects only this process's liveTransports, and natsOutageTick (the only caller) runs in supervise. recordTransportSelection refreshes last_fallback_at only on a new open, and resolveTransport returns the cached transport without reopening, so a long-lived non-supervisor holder never refreshes. Once that is older than OUTAGE_RETIRE_MS, retireStaleOutage closes it and doctor clears.
findings.fix: Have each long-lived process that holds a fallback refresh last_fallback_at periodically (for example from the presence or transport heartbeat), or document that retirement reflects only supervisor and new-open activity.
